connect_four.title: Connect Four
connect_four.objective: Connect four own discs; alternate moves on a public board.
connect_four.opponent_policy: Win immediately if possible, block an immediate loss, otherwise prefer central legal columns.
connect_four.selection: purposive coverage sample, not a random sample of all games

nim.title: Nim
nim.objective: Remove objects from one pile; taking the last object wins.
nim.opponent_policy: Use a zero-nim-sum move when available; otherwise remove one from a nonempty pile.
nim.selection: purposive coverage sample, not a random sample of all games

kuhn_poker.title: Kuhn Poker
kuhn_poker.objective: Win more chips over the native sequence of three-card poker rounds.
kuhn_poker.opponent_policy: Card-aware stochastic betting and calling using only own card and public legal actions.
kuhn_poker.selection: purposive coverage sample, not a random sample of all games

liars_dice.title: Liar's Dice
liars_dice.objective: Bid about dice counts or challenge; the last player retaining dice wins.
liars_dice.opponent_policy: Estimate public bids from own dice plus the expected unseen count; challenge implausible bids.
liars_dice.selection: purposive coverage sample, not a random sample of all games

blind_auction.title: Blind Auction
blind_auction.action_format: Free conversation, then [Bid on Item X: amount]
blind_auction.objective: Maximize final net worth by bidding on items with private valuations.
blind_auction.opponent_policy: Converse neutrally; bid 55–80% of own values, proportionally capped by own remaining capital.
blind_auction.selection: purposive coverage sample, not a random sample of all games

negotiation.title: Resource Negotiation
negotiation.objective: Trade resources to increase inventory value under private valuations.
negotiation.opponent_policy: Accept affordable nonnegative-value offers; otherwise propose an affordable exchange with positive own value.
negotiation.selection: purposive coverage sample, not a random sample of all games

prisoners_dilemma.title: Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma
prisoners_dilemma.objective: Accumulate points through repeated simultaneous cooperation/defection decisions.
prisoners_dilemma.opponent_policy: Tit-for-tat from the last publicly resolved round, initially cooperative; neutral conversation.
prisoners_dilemma.selection: purposive coverage sample, not a random sample of all games

colonel_blotto.title: Colonel Blotto
colonel_blotto.objective: Allocate a fixed budget across battlefields; win a majority of fields and rounds.
colonel_blotto.opponent_policy: Randomly distribute the full budget across a randomly chosen majority of fields.
colonel_blotto.selection: purposive coverage sample, not a random sample of all games

pig_dice.title: Pig Dice
pig_dice.objective: Accumulate and bank points while risking loss of the unbanked turn total.
pig_dice.opponent_policy: Hold at eight unbanked points or when banking reaches the winning score; otherwise roll.
pig_dice.selection: purposive coverage sample, not a random sample of all games

tower_of_hanoi.title: Tower of Hanoi
tower_of_hanoi.objective: Move the ordered disk stack from tower A to tower C.
tower_of_hanoi.selection: purposive coverage sample, not a random sample of all games

mastermind.title: Mastermind
mastermind.objective: Infer a hidden code from black/white peg feedback.
mastermind.selection: purposive coverage sample, not a random sample of all games

wordle.title: Wordle
wordle.objective: Infer a hidden word from letter-position feedback.
wordle.selection: purposive coverage sample, not a random sample of all games
